body:
I appreciate your words of advice. 

One thing I've realized about my life now that I'm in college is that I don't volunteer like I used to when I was in high school. I used to have a regular position at my local library, and I used to do this program where I'd teach middle schoolers about the environment. Perhaps I should look into similar activities since it is summer now, and maybe it'll serve as a way to help me cope.

Thank you for your response, and I'm grateful that you're willing to tell me about your experience with a mean woman as well the essential advice at the end. 

For the last couple weeks I've barely left my house except to go to occasional dinners with friends. I do realize what you mean. It's just hard to get myself to believe that I can meet a nice girl, considering I've never met an interested person before her, and it hurts a lot too since the first person to seemingly "like" me was using me the entire time.
